title: Evidence Status
description: Optional per-pair honesty label at `results/{pair_id}/evidence_status.json`. It tells dashboard consumers whether the currently displayed winner is merely the best rule found in a broad search, still needs a fresh confirmation test, or has passed that confirmation. Missing files default to `found_in_search` in the app.

schema_version.description: Instance schema version. 1.1.0 adds the optional `final_exam` lineage block. 1.2.0 adds `failed_final_exam` status and `failure_reasons` array.

status.description: `found_in_search` — winner selected from tournament, no confirmation test run. `needs_final_exam` — confirmation planned but not yet run. `passed_final_exam` — holdout/confirmation test run and passed. `failed_final_exam` — holdout/confirmation test was run but did not pass; exam results are documented and displayed to users as informational disclosure.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the evidence-status decision.

confirmation_test.description: Name of the final-exam/confirmation method, when applicable.

plain_english.description: Optional pair-specific plain-English wording. If omitted, the app uses canonical ELI5 copy for the status enum.

technical_note.description: Optional technical note documenting the statistical reason for the status.

next_step.description: Optional next action, especially for `found_in_search` or `needs_final_exam`.

owner.description: Agent or human who made the evidence-status decision.

failure_reasons.description: Required when status is `failed_final_exam`. One entry per failed ECON-FE1 condition, in plain English. Displayed verbatim as a disclosure banner to portal users.

frozen_rule_id.description: Stable identifier for the frozen selected rule.

frozen_at.description: Timestamp at which the rule was frozen before confirmation.

n_trials_raw.description: Raw count of eligible tournament/search recipes.

n_trials_effective.description: Effective number of independent recipes after collapsing highly correlated variants.

thresholds_version.description: Version tag for the final-exam pass/fail thresholds.

result_artifact.description: Path to the companion final-exam results artifact.
